metadata.technology_specification: Benchtop flow cytometer with optical fluorescence detection
metadata.technology_reasoning: Benchtop flow cytometers with optical fluorescence detection are the most widespread in research and clinical labs as of 2024 due to their versatility, multi-parameter analysis capability, and established technology integration.

components.reasoning: Essential subsystem that transports cells in a fluid stream through the laser interrogation point, universally present in all flow cytometers.

Core to fluorescence excitation and emission capture, includes lasers as excitation sources and optical filters and dichroic mirrors for signal separation, always procured as distinct optical subassemblies.
Detect fluorescence and scattered light signals, critical and separate electronic components, nearly universal across flow cytometer models.
Includes analog and digital electronics for signal amplification, conversion, and data acquisition; standardized component with distinct supply chain.
Interface for introducing samples into the fluidics system, typically a separate assembly with precise control.
Controls instrument operation and data analysis, usually provided as a separate system/software with dedicated hardware interface.
Structural housing that integrates all subsystems, procured as a distinct manufactured assembly providing user interface and protection.

Fluidics System.name: Polyvinyl chloride
Fluidics System.reasoning: Used commonly for tubing and fluidic channels due to chemical resistance and flexibility; standard material for fluid handling in flow cytometers.

Fluidics System.name: Stainless steel
Fluidics System.reasoning: Used for fluidic valves, fittings, and some structural elements for corrosion resistance and strength; common in fluidic component manufactures.

Fluidics System.name: Glass
Fluidics System.reasoning: Utilized in microfluidic channels and flow cells for optical transparency and chemical inertness; alternatives exist but glass is standard.

Fluidics System.name: Epoxy resins
Fluidics System.reasoning: Used for bonding and sealing components in fluidic systems; good mechanical stability and chemical resistance.

Optical System (Lasers and Filters).name: Aluminum gallium arsenide
Optical System (Lasers and Filters).reasoning: Key semiconductor material for laser diodes in flow cytometers; industry standard for visible laser emission.

Optical System (Lasers and Filters).name: Borosilicate glass
Optical System (Lasers and Filters).reasoning: Used in optical filters and lenses for precise optical properties and thermal stability; widely used in optical components.

Optical System (Lasers and Filters).name: Titanium dioxide
Optical System (Lasers and Filters).reasoning: Common coating material for optical filters and anti-reflection coatings; used to enhance optical performance.

Optical System (Lasers and Filters).name: Silver
Optical System (Lasers and Filters).reasoning: Used in reflective coatings on mirrors and filters to maximize reflectivity; can be substituted but common.

Electronics and Signal Processing Module.name: Copper
Electronics and Signal Processing Module.reasoning: Used extensively for electrical conductors including printed circuit board traces and wiring; industry standard.

Electronics and Signal Processing Module.name: Epoxy resins

Electronics and Signal Processing Module.name: Aluminum

Sample Injection Port and Controller.name: Acrylic

Sample Injection Port and Controller.name: Polycarbonate

Computer Interface and Software Module.name: Polyethylene terephthalate
Computer Interface and Software Module.reasoning: Used in insulating films and flexible printed circuits; common but alternatives are possible.

Instrument Chassis and Enclosure.name: Stainless steel
